curriculum.name: Example Expert Curriculum
curriculum.capability_target: Independently understand, apply, audit, and extend the core methods of Example Domain.
curriculum.purpose: Build operational command rather than passive familiarity.

groups.name: Foundations
groups.role: Supply the primitive vocabulary and operations required by all later groups.
exit_gate: Solve representative foundational problems without help.
Distinguish the main neighboring concepts that are commonly confused.

groups.name: Core Methods
groups.role: Develop the methods that control later application.
exit_gate: Apply the core methods to unfamiliar problems.

groups.name: Application Branch
groups.start_gate: Group 01 core pass complete; activate only when this application becomes relevant.
groups.role: Apply the spine to a specialized domain.
exit_gate: Complete one domain-specific analysis or build using standard definitions.
